title: Health Resort west wing office room 112 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 112 of the Health Resort West wing on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing office room 112 key (W112 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing office room 112.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- On a seat in a bus at the bus depot

- On a desk in west wing room 105 at the health resort.

- In a key rack in west wing room 202 at the health resort.

- On the floor below a key rack in the utility room next to west wing room 227 at the health resort.

- On the floor in the hallway in front of east wing room 112 at the health resort.

- In the key rack near the central stairs on the second floor of the east wing at the health resort.

- On the floor below a key rack near the central stairs on the third floor of the east wing at the health resort.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The first floor of the west wing in the Health Resort on the map Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Yellow keycard spawn location
- Blue keycard spawn location
- Loose Loot (Provisions) on the table left of the door
- Two Sport bags
